derivation: plural from the same as H7704 (שָׂדֶה); flats;

occurrences.text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
